_why: The keynote-ui register: Apple-keynote UI explainer — kinetic words + iOS-style widgets, page-turn cuts that flip the field, UI springs with a small overshoot, shutter motion blur on everything fast. Distilled and MEASURED from a reference on 2026-10-08 (references/preset-keynote-ui.md). Same lock discipline as the film register: decided before any frame, never broken.
name: <brand> — keynote-ui
_palette_rule: 3 colours. The FIELD alternates bg ↔ ink between shots (light page / dark page); on a dark field the ink becomes the type colour bg. Accent = ONE thing per shot. Card white or tints go in extra_allowed with a reason.

type._rule: One family. Words land one at a time. Headline 6–10 % of frame height, sub-line 2–3 %.

background: Flat field with a soft radial light (centre +4 % luma) and, optionally, a faint 1 px grid at 4 % alpha. The field flips light↔dark on every hard cut.

music.feel: calm electronic, sub-heavy, plucked arpeggio over a sustained pad (reference measured 83 BPM)
music._bands: 60–80 regal/cinematic · 90–110 smooth/effortless · 115–123 kinetic (practitioner convention); keynote-ui sits at the low edge of smooth

sfx._rule: UI sounds, never cinematic hits: blip (an object lands), ratchet (a value rolls), shimmer (a morph), whoosh (a page turn, soft). Each names the event it marks.

shots._rule: A cut is a page turn: it lands on a phrase AND flips the field. Inside a page, objects morph into each other (pill → pill, rectangle → card, dot → icon → widget).

motion._shutter: 720° at 60 fps = the reference's 33 ms exposure at 30 fps (gotcha 31).
motion._rule: Objects land on MS.SPRINGS.ui (~5 % overshoot, settled by 0.62 s), words on settle. Exits accelerate (power3.in, 0.25–0.35 s) and smear. Blur comes from the shutter, never a CSS blur on a moving thing.

banned: linear moves except a hold drift
more than one accent per shot
